blocks.zh: 污染控制策略的要素
blocks.en: Elements of a Contamination Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) 的整體架構，包含基礎要素、個別控制元素、驗證、監控與治理層級
blocks.en: Understand the overall architecture of a Contamination Control Strategy (CCS), including the foundational elements, individual control elements, validation, monitoring, and governance levels

blocks.zh: 掌握 CCS 三大基礎要素：Scientific Knowledge（科學知識）、Quality Risk Management（品質風險管理）、Personnel Awareness & Quality Culture（人員意識與品質文化）
blocks.en: Master the three foundational elements of a CCS: Scientific Knowledge, Quality Risk Management (QRM), and Personnel Awareness & Quality Culture

blocks.zh: 了解 QRM 原則如何應用於新舊製程的污染控制設計，以及冗餘控制的重要性
blocks.en: Understand how QRM principles apply to contamination control design for new and existing processes, and why redundant controls matter

blocks.zh: 認識品質文化 (Quality Culture) 對 CCS 成效的直接影響，以及各層級人員在 CCS 中的角色與責任
blocks.en: Recognize the direct impact of quality culture on CCS effectiveness, and the roles and responsibilities of personnel at each level within the CCS

blocks.zh: 3.0 Elements of a Contamination Control Strategy 3.0 污染控制策略要素
blocks.en: 3.0 Elements of a Contamination Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Contamination Control Strategy, CCS (污染控制策略)：這不是一份單獨的文件，而是一套系統性的整合架構。CCS 將藥品品質系統 (PQS) 與 GMP 措施中與污染控制相關的所有元素串聯起來，形成一個多層次、環環相扣的防護網。
blocks.en: Contamination Control Strategy (CCS): This is not a single document but a systematic, integrated framework. The CCS links together all contamination-control-related elements of the Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS) and GMP measures, forming a multi-layered, interlocking safety net.

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 的連結：TR90 明確指出 CCS 的基礎要素與 ICH Q10 中的「促進因子 (Enablers)」——即知識管理與品質風險管理——完全一致。這表示 CCS 並非獨立於現有品質體系之外的新系統，而是將既有框架聚焦於「污染控制」這個核心目標。
blocks.en: Link to ICH Q10: TR90 states explicitly that the foundational elements of a CCS are fully consistent with the "Enablers" in ICH Q10, namely knowledge management and quality risk management. This means the CCS is not a new system separate from the existing quality system; it focuses the existing framework on the core goal of contamination control.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Figure 3.0-1🔍 Analysis
blocks.en: Figure 3.0-1🔍 Analysis

blocks.zh: Figure 3.0-1🔍 是理解整個 TR90 的關鍵圖。它以色彩分層展示 CCS 的五個層級：
blocks.en: Figure 3.0-1🔍 is the key figure for understanding TR90 as a whole. It uses color-coded layers to show the five levels of the CCS:

blocks.zh: 深藍色（底層）= 基礎要素：科學知識、QRM、人員意識/品質文化 — 這是一切的根基
blocks.en: Dark blue (bottom layer) = foundational elements: scientific knowledge, QRM, personnel awareness/quality culture. This is the base for everything else.

blocks.zh: 紅色 = 個別控制元素：製程設計、設施設計、設備、清潔消毒、環境監控等具體措施
blocks.en: Red = individual control elements: specific measures such as process design, facility design, equipment, cleaning and disinfection, and environmental monitoring

blocks.zh: 綠色 = 確效 (Validation)：證明每個控制元素確實能達到預期的控制水準
blocks.en: Green = validation: demonstrates that each control element actually achieves the intended level of control

blocks.zh: 紫色 = 監控 (Monitoring)：持續驗證控制措施在日常運作中仍然有效
blocks.en: Purple = monitoring: continually verifies that control measures remain effective in routine operation

blocks.zh: 淺藍色（頂層）= 治理 (Governance)：從全局角度審視所有 CCS 元素的整體效果
blocks.en: Light blue (top layer) = governance: reviews the overall effectiveness of all CCS elements from a holistic perspective

blocks.zh: 請特別注意：圖中還有回饋迴路 (Feedback Loops)，包含偏差調查、變更管制、CAPA，這些機制確保 CCS 能持續改進而不是一成不變。
blocks.en: Note in particular the feedback loops in the figure, which include deviation investigation, change control, and CAPA. These mechanisms ensure the CCS keeps improving rather than staying static.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 CCS 想像成醫院的感染管控計畫。醫院不是只靠一項措施來防止院內感染——它需要同時具備：醫學知識（基礎）、洗手消毒程序（個別控制）、定期稽核確認程序有效（確效）、持續監測感染率（監控）、以及院長層級的定期檢討會議（治理）。任何一環薄弱，整個防感染體系就會出現漏洞。
blocks.en: Think of the CCS as a hospital infection control program. A hospital does not prevent hospital-acquired infections with a single measure. It needs all of the following at once: medical knowledge (foundation), handwashing and disinfection procedures (individual controls), regular audits to confirm the procedures work (validation), ongoing surveillance of infection rates (monitoring), and periodic review meetings at the hospital director level (governance). If any one link is weak, gaps appear in the whole infection prevention system.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 原文特別強調："A weakness in any of these elements or a mismatch between elements can lead to an ineffective CCS."
blocks.en: The source text stresses: "A weakness in any of these elements or a mismatch between elements can lead to an ineffective CCS."

blocks.zh: 這句話有兩層含義：
blocks.en: This sentence carries two meanings:

blocks.zh: 單一要素的弱點就足以讓整個策略失效（木桶原理——最短的板決定水位）
blocks.en: A weakness in a single element is enough to make the whole strategy fail (the barrel principle: the shortest stave sets the water level)

blocks.zh: 要素之間的不匹配同樣危險。例如設施設計先進但人員訓練不足，或者監控系統完善但治理審查機制鬆散，都是典型的「mismatch」
blocks.en: A mismatch between elements is equally dangerous. For example, an advanced facility design with insufficiently trained personnel, or a thorough monitoring system with a lax governance review mechanism, are both typical "mismatches"

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果你負責建立一個新產品的 CCS，你會先從 Figure 3.0-1🔍 的哪一層開始？為什麼？
blocks.en: If you were responsible for building a CCS for a new product, which level of Figure 3.0-1🔍 would you start from, and why?

blocks.zh: 在你目前的工作場所中，CCS 的哪一個層級最可能是「最弱的一環」？為什麼？
blocks.en: In your current workplace, which level of the CCS is most likely to be the "weakest link", and why?

blocks.zh: 3.1 Foundations of a Contamination Control Strategy 3.1 污染控制策略之基礎
blocks.en: 3.1 Foundations of a Contamination Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 3.1 節明確指出 CCS 的三大基礎支柱。這三項不是「可選的加分項」，而是開發有效 CCS 的前提條件 (prerequisites)。如果缺乏科學知識，你無法識別風險；缺乏 QRM，你無法評估和排序風險；缺乏品質文化，你無法確保措施被確實執行。
blocks.en: Section 3.1 states explicitly the three foundational pillars of a CCS. These are not "optional extras" but prerequisites for developing an effective CCS. Without scientific knowledge you cannot identify risks; without QRM you cannot assess and prioritize them; without a quality culture you cannot ensure that the measures are actually carried out.

blocks.zh: 3.1.1 Scientific Knowledge Foundational Element 3.1.1 科學知識基礎要素
blocks.en: 3.1.1 Scientific Knowledge Foundational Element

blocks.zh: Scientific Knowledge (科學知識)：TR90 將科學知識分為兩大類：
blocks.en: Scientific Knowledge: TR90 divides scientific knowledge into two categories:

blocks.zh: Process Knowledge（製程知識）：了解你的具體製程在哪裡、如何可能受到污染
blocks.en: Process Knowledge: understanding where and how your specific process can become contaminated

blocks.zh: Technical Knowledge（技術知識）：了解防止污染的通用原理與最佳實務
blocks.en: Technical Knowledge: understanding the general principles and best practices for preventing contamination

blocks.zh: 這兩者缺一不可。只有製程知識而不懂防污染技術，你知道問題在哪但不知道怎麼解決；只有技術知識而不了解製程，你有工具但不知道用在哪裡。
blocks.en: You need both. With process knowledge but no knowledge of contamination prevention techniques, you know where the problem is but not how to solve it; with technical knowledge but no understanding of the process, you have the tools but do not know where to apply them.

blocks.zh: Process Knowledge 清單中的六大面向，本質上是在回答三個關鍵問題：
blocks.en: The six aspects in the Process Knowledge list are essentially answering three key questions:

blocks.zh: 污染從哪裡進來？（Ingress points — 進入點）
blocks.en: Where does contamination come in? (Ingress points)

blocks.zh: 污染會不會在製程中增殖？（Proliferation points — 增殖點；Microbial growth potential — 微生物生長潛力）
blocks.en: Can contamination proliferate during the process? (Proliferation points; microbial growth potential)

blocks.zh: 製程能移除多少污染？（Removal/reduction capability — 移除/降低能力）
blocks.en: How much contamination can the process remove? (Removal/reduction capability)

blocks.zh: 加上歷史數據（contamination events and trends），這就構成了完整的風險圖譜。注意：病毒相關面向僅適用於使用活細胞系統的製程（如生物製劑）。
blocks.en: Adding historical data (contamination events and trends) completes the risk picture. Note: the virus-related aspects apply only to processes that use live cell systems (such as biologics).

blocks.zh: 想像你是一位城市防洪工程師。你需要兩類知識：
blocks.en: Imagine you are a city flood control engineer. You need two kinds of knowledge:

blocks.zh: 製程知識 = 了解你的城市：哪些地勢低窪容易積水（ingress points）？哪些區域排水不良會讓水位持續上升（proliferation）？現有的堤防和排水系統能承受多大雨量（removal capability）？過去哪裡曾經淹過水（history）？
blocks.en: Process knowledge = knowing your city: Which areas are low-lying and prone to waterlogging (ingress points)? Which areas drain poorly so that water keeps rising (proliferation)? How much rainfall can the existing levees and drainage systems handle (removal capability)? Where has flooding occurred in the past (history)?

blocks.zh: 技術知識 = 了解防洪工程原理：如何設計堤防、怎麼建造排水系統、泵站的規格該怎麼選——這些是通用的工程知識，不管放到哪個城市都適用。
blocks.en: Technical knowledge = knowing flood control engineering principles: how to design levees, how to build drainage systems, how to select pump station specifications. This is general engineering knowledge that applies in any city.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Technical Knowledge 參考文獻整理
blocks.en: Key Notes: Summary of Technical Knowledge References

blocks.zh: TR90 在 Technical Knowledge 部分引用了大量 PDA 技術報告作為支撐。這反映出 CCS 是一個跨領域的綜合策略。以下是按主題分類的參考文獻地圖：
blocks.en: In its Technical Knowledge section, TR90 cites many PDA technical reports as support, which reflects that the CCS is a cross-disciplinary, comprehensive strategy. The following is a map of the references by topic:

blocks.zh: 微生物學基礎：TR69（生物負荷與生物膜管理）
blocks.en: Microbiology fundamentals: TR69 (bioburden and biofilm management)

blocks.zh: 無菌製程：PDA Points to Consider（無菌充填 Parts 1 & 2）
blocks.en: Aseptic processing: PDA Points to Consider (Aseptic Fill/Finish, Parts 1 & 2)

blocks.zh: 病毒控制：TR83（病毒污染）、TR41（病毒過濾）
blocks.en: Virus control: TR83 (viral contamination), TR41 (virus filtration)

blocks.zh: 製程設計與確效：TR42, TR44, TR60, TR81
blocks.en: Process design and validation: TR42, TR44, TR60, TR81

blocks.zh: 設施/設備設計：ISPE Baseline Guide Vol.3、TR34
blocks.en: Facility/equipment design: ISPE Baseline Guide Vol. 3, TR34

blocks.zh: 清潔與滅菌：TR1, TR3, TR26, TR29, TR48, TR49, TR61, TR70, USP <1072>
blocks.en: Cleaning and sterilization: TR1, TR3, TR26, TR29, TR48, TR49, TR61, TR70, USP <1072>

blocks.zh: 原物料品質：ICH Q7A
blocks.en: Raw material quality: ICH Q7A

blocks.zh: 風險管理：TR54, ICH Q9
blocks.en: Risk management: TR54, ICH Q9

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這意味著建立 CCS 團隊時，需要包含微生物學、工程、品保、製程開發等多領域專家。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means the CCS team needs experts from multiple fields, including microbiology, engineering, quality assurance, and process development.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，你可能同時服務多個客戶的不同產品。每個產品的 Process Knowledge 都不同——有的是小分子無菌充填、有的是細胞治療產品、有的是生物製劑。但 Technical Knowledge 有很大部分是共通的。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, you may serve multiple clients with different products at the same time. The Process Knowledge for each product differs: some are small-molecule aseptic fills, some are cell therapy products, and some are biologics. But a large part of the Technical Knowledge is common to all.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：建立一個跨產品的「技術知識資料庫」（引用 TR90 列出的所有參考文獻），然後針對每個產品/客戶開發專屬的 Process Knowledge 評估。這樣既能確保知識的完整性，又能提高效率。
blocks.en: Practical recommendation: Build a cross-product "technical knowledge database" (citing all the references listed in TR90), then develop a dedicated Process Knowledge assessment for each product/client. This ensures the knowledge is complete while improving efficiency.

blocks.zh: 針對你最熟悉的一個製程，試著列出至少三個 ingress points 和兩個 proliferation points。
blocks.en: For the process you know best, try to list at least three ingress points and two proliferation points.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 要求將 contamination events history 納入科學知識？這對一個全新產品（沒有歷史數據）的 CCS 有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 require contamination events history to be included in scientific knowledge? What does this mean for the CCS of a brand-new product (with no history)?

blocks.zh: 在生物製劑 (biologics) 與小分子藥物 (small molecules) 的 CCS 中，Process Knowledge 的評估重點有何不同？
blocks.en: How do the focus areas of the Process Knowledge assessment differ between the CCS for biologics and for small molecule drugs?

blocks.zh: 3.1.2 Quality Risk Management Foundational Element 3.1.2 品質風險管理基礎要素
blocks.en: 3.1.2 Quality Risk Management Foundational Element

blocks.zh: Quality Risk Management, QRM (品質風險管理)：QRM 在 CCS 中的角色是作為「決策引擎」。所有的控制措施設計都應該基於風險評估的結果來決定——在哪裡投入更多資源、在哪裡可以適度簡化。
blocks.en: Quality Risk Management (QRM): The role of QRM in the CCS is that of a "decision engine". The design of all control measures should be based on the results of risk assessment: where to invest more resources and where simplification is acceptable.

blocks.zh: Redundant Control Elements（冗餘控制元素）：這是一個關鍵原則——CCS 必須設計成沒有任何單一失效點 (single point of failure)。當一個控制元素失效時，其他元素仍能防止污染發生。這就像飛機有多套獨立的液壓系統一樣。
blocks.en: Redundant Control Elements: This is a key principle. The CCS must be designed with no single point of failure. When one control element fails, other elements can still prevent contamination from occurring. It is like an aircraft having multiple independent hydraulic systems.

blocks.zh: 把「開放式 vs. 封閉式製程」的控制需求想像成在不同環境中保護一盤壽司：
blocks.en: Think of the control needs of "open vs. closed processes" as protecting a plate of sushi in different environments:

blocks.zh: 封閉式製程 = 壽司放在密封的保鮮盒裡：只需要基本的溫度控制就能安全保存
blocks.en: Closed process = sushi in a sealed container: basic temperature control is enough to keep it safe

blocks.zh: 開放式製程 = 壽司放在露天攤位上：你需要防蟲網、防塵罩、溫度監控、定時更換、人員衛生管理、周圍環境清潔......每一項額外措施都是成本
blocks.en: Open process = sushi at an open-air stall: you need insect netting, dust covers, temperature monitoring, scheduled replacement, staff hygiene management, cleaning of the surroundings, and so on. Every additional measure is a cost.

blocks.zh: TR90 的訊息很明確：在設計階段就選擇較高的工程控制水準（如封閉系統），可以大幅降低整個產品生命週期的營運複雜度和成本。
blocks.en: The message of TR90 is clear: choosing a higher level of engineering control (such as a closed system) at the design stage can greatly reduce operational complexity and cost over the whole product lifecycle.

blocks.zh: 原文中有一段非常重要的經濟學邏輯：
blocks.en: The source text contains a very important piece of economic logic:

blocks.zh: 這段話的意涵是：前期在設計上省的錢，後期會以數倍的營運成本還回來。一個設計不良的設施，終其一生都需要更多的人員、更複雜的程序、更頻繁的監控來彌補設計缺陷。這對 CDMO 的設施投資決策有重大影響。
blocks.en: The implication is: money saved on design up front is paid back later several times over in operating costs. A poorly designed facility will need more personnel, more complex procedures, and more frequent monitoring throughout its life to compensate for design shortcomings. This has major implications for CDMO facility investment decisions.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Innovation Opportunity
blocks.en: Key Notes: Innovation Opportunity

blocks.zh: TR90 特別指出新建或翻新是導入創新的最佳時機。具體包括：
blocks.en: TR90 specifically points out that a new build or renovation is the best time to introduce innovation. This specifically includes:

blocks.zh: Closed or barrier systems（封閉或屏障系統）：如隔離器 (Isolator)、RABS
blocks.en: Closed or barrier systems: such as isolators and RABS

blocks.zh: Automation（自動化）：減少人員介入，降低最大的污染源——人
blocks.en: Automation: reduces personnel intervention, and so reduces the largest source of contamination, people

blocks.zh: Advanced monitoring and detection（先進監控與偵測技術）：如即時微生物偵測、連續粒子監測
blocks.en: Advanced monitoring and detection: such as rapid microbial detection and continuous particle monitoring

blocks.zh: 如果你的工廠正在規劃擴建或翻修，這正是重新審視 CCS 並進行升級的黃金機會。
blocks.en: If your site is planning an expansion or renovation, this is a golden opportunity to revisit the CCS and upgrade it.

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：假設一位客戶要求你們代工一個需要在開放環境下進行手動操作的無菌充填步驟。根據 TR90 的 QRM 原則，你需要：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Suppose a client asks you to manufacture a product that requires a manual aseptic filling step in an open environment. Under the QRM principles of TR90, you would need to:

blocks.zh: 評估該開放步驟帶來的額外風險
blocks.en: Assess the additional risk that the open step introduces

blocks.zh: 設計冗餘控制措施（單向氣流保護、人員動線管控、更嚴格的環境監控）
blocks.en: Design redundant control measures (unidirectional airflow protection, personnel flow control, stricter environmental monitoring)

blocks.zh: 計算這些額外措施的長期成本
blocks.en: Calculate the long-term cost of these additional measures

blocks.zh: 向客戶提議是否可改用封閉系統設計來降低整體成本
blocks.en: Propose to the client whether a closed-system design could be used instead to reduce overall cost

blocks.zh: 這是 CDMO 展現技術領導力並為客戶創造價值的機會。
blocks.en: This is an opportunity for the CDMO to demonstrate technical leadership and create value for the client.

blocks.zh: 在你的製造環境中，有哪些步驟目前是「開放式」的？如果改為「封閉式」，需要哪些投資？可以省去哪些日常營運成本？
blocks.en: In your manufacturing environment, which steps are currently "open"? If they were made "closed", what investment would be needed, and which routine operating costs could be eliminated?

blocks.zh: 什麼是「冗餘控制」？試舉一個你工作中的實際例子，說明當某一控制失效時，哪個備援控制會接手。
blocks.en: What is a "redundant control"? Give a real example from your work showing which backup control takes over when one control fails.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 建議新的污染控制技術需要經過 QRM 評估才能導入？直接採用最新技術不好嗎？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 recommend that new contamination control technologies be evaluated through QRM before being introduced? Wouldn't it be better to adopt the latest technology directly?

blocks.zh: 3.1.3 Personnel Awareness and Quality Culture Foundational Element 3.1.3 人員意識與品質文化基礎要素
blocks.en: 3.1.3 Personnel Awareness and Quality Culture Foundational Element

blocks.zh: Quality Culture (品質文化)：品質文化不是掛在牆上的標語，而是組織中每個人在面對壓力、衝突、截止日期時，仍然會優先考慮品質和安全的集體行為模式。TR90 將其列為 CCS 的基礎要素，表明再好的技術控制措施，如果沒有正確的文化支撐，都可能流於形式。
blocks.en: Quality Culture: Quality culture is not a slogan on the wall. It is the collective pattern of behavior in which everyone in the organization still puts quality and safety first when facing pressure, conflict, and deadlines. TR90 lists it as a foundational element of the CCS, indicating that even the best technical controls can become a mere formality without the right culture to support them.

blocks.zh: Training vs. Education (訓練 vs. 教育)：這是一個經常被忽略的重要區分：
blocks.en: Training vs. Education: This is an important distinction that is often overlooked:

blocks.zh: Training（訓練）：教人「做什麼」和「怎麼做」— 操作程序、SOP 執行
blocks.en: Training: teaches people "what to do" and "how to do it" (operating procedures, SOP execution)

blocks.zh: Education（教育）：教人「為什麼這樣做」— 背後的科學原理和風險邏輯
blocks.en: Education: teaches people "why it is done this way" (the underlying scientific principles and risk logic)

blocks.zh: 只有訓練沒有教育的人，在遇到 SOP 未涵蓋的異常狀況時，無法做出正確判斷。
blocks.en: People who have only training and no education cannot make sound judgments when they encounter an abnormal situation that the SOP does not cover.

blocks.zh: 品質文化就像一個家庭的「家風」。你可以制定再多的家規（SOP），但如果家庭成員的核心價值觀不一致，規則就不會被認真遵守。
blocks.en: Quality culture is like the "family tradition" of a household. You can set as many house rules (SOPs) as you like, but if family members do not share the same core values, the rules will not be taken seriously.

blocks.zh: TR90 列出的品質文化特徵中，「Non-blaming culture（非責怪文化）」特別值得關注。這就像航空業的安全報告文化——如果飛行員因為報告險情而受到懲罰，以後就沒有人敢報告了，而問題會在暗處累積直到發生重大事故。
blocks.en: Among the characteristics of quality culture listed in TR90, the "non-blaming culture" deserves particular attention. It is like the safety reporting culture in aviation: if pilots are punished for reporting near-misses, no one will dare to report in the future, and problems will accumulate unseen until a major accident occurs.

blocks.zh: 同理，如果操作人員因為主動報告異常而被責備，他們下次就會選擇沉默，而污染風險就此被隱藏起來。
blocks.en: Likewise, if operators are blamed for proactively reporting abnormalities, they will choose to stay silent next time, and contamination risks will stay hidden.

blocks.zh: TR90 有兩個特別強烈的聲明值得銘記：
blocks.en: TR90 makes two especially strong statements worth remembering:

blocks.zh: "One-time or annual training does not ensure ongoing awareness." — 一次性或年度訓練不足以維持持續的意識。這對許多公司的訓練體系是一個挑戰，因為大多數訓練計畫都是按年度週期設計的。
blocks.en: "One-time or annual training does not ensure ongoing awareness." One-time or annual training is not sufficient to sustain ongoing awareness. This is a challenge for the training systems of many companies, because most training programs are designed around an annual cycle.

blocks.zh: "Shop floor personnel are the true guardians of contamination control." — 第一線操作人員才是污染控制的真正守護者。這句話翻轉了許多組織中「品質是品保部門的責任」的錯誤觀念。
blocks.en: "Shop floor personnel are the true guardians of contamination control." Shop floor operators are the true guardians of contamination control. This statement overturns the mistaken notion held in many organizations that "quality is the responsibility of the QA department".

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Table 3.1.3-1 Analysis
blocks.en: Table 3.1.3-1 Analysis

blocks.zh: Table 3.1.3-1 定義了三個層級的 CCS 角色：
blocks.en: Table 3.1.3-1 defines CCS roles at three levels:

blocks.zh: Leadership（領導層）：負責「定方向」— 將污染預防列為組織優先事項，推動非責怪文化，確保人員配置得當
blocks.en: Leadership: responsible for "setting direction": making contamination prevention an organizational priority, promoting a non-blaming culture, and ensuring appropriate staffing

blocks.zh: Expert（專家層）：負責「看全局」— 監督控制措施的表現，提升污染危害，提供技術領導以持續改進
blocks.en: Expert: responsible for "seeing the big picture": overseeing the performance of control measures, escalating contamination hazards, and providing technical leadership for continual improvement

blocks.zh: Shop Floor（現場操作層）：負責「做實事」— 實際執行污染控制、報告問題、提供對個別控制元素的技術專業意見
blocks.en: Shop Floor: responsible for "getting things done": actually carrying out contamination control, reporting problems, and providing technical expertise on individual control elements

blocks.zh: 注意：所有三個層級都有「Escalates contamination hazards（提升污染危害的通報）」的職責。這表示通報責任不分層級——從操作員到專家都有義務提出警示。
blocks.en: Note: all three levels have the duty of "Escalates contamination hazards". This means the responsibility to escalate applies at every level, from operators to experts, who all have an obligation to raise alerts.

blocks.zh: CDMO 挑戰：CDMO 的品質文化面臨獨特的挑戰——人員流動率可能較高、同一設施可能同時服務多個客戶的不同產品、操作人員需要頻繁切換製程。
blocks.en: CDMO challenge: The quality culture of a CDMO faces unique challenges: staff turnover may be higher, the same facility may serve different products for multiple clients, and operators need to switch between processes frequently.

blocks.zh: 建議做法：
blocks.en: Recommended practices:

blocks.zh: 建立一個跨產品的「污染控制意識推廣計畫」，而非僅依賴產品別的訓練
blocks.en: Establish a cross-product "contamination control awareness program" rather than relying only on product-specific training

blocks.zh: 每季而非每年進行污染控制的持續教育（mini-education sessions），搭配實際案例分享
blocks.en: Provide ongoing contamination control education every quarter rather than every year (mini-education sessions), combined with sharing of real cases

blocks.zh: 設立「CCS Champion」或專責團隊，如 TR90 建議的，定期審視整體 CCS 表現
blocks.en: Set up a "CCS Champion" or a dedicated team, as TR90 recommends, to review overall CCS performance regularly

blocks.zh: 建立匿名的「Near-miss」報告系統，強化非責怪文化
blocks.en: Set up an anonymous "near-miss" reporting system to strengthen the non-blaming culture

blocks.zh: 你的組織中，品質文化的八項特徵中，最強和最弱的各是哪一項？為什麼？
blocks.en: Of the eight characteristics of quality culture, which is the strongest and which is the weakest in your organization, and why?

blocks.zh: 「Training」和「Education」在你的現有訓練計畫中各佔多少比重？如何增加「Education」的成分？
blocks.en: What proportion of your current training program is "Training" and what proportion is "Education"? How could you increase the "Education" component?

blocks.zh: 如果你是一位現場操作主管，你會如何在不增加太多額外時間負擔的情況下，維持團隊的持續污染控制意識？
blocks.en: If you were a shop floor supervisor, how would you maintain your team's ongoing contamination control awareness without adding much extra time burden?

blocks.zh: Table 3.1.3-1 中，為什麼所有三個角色都包含「Escalates contamination hazards」？這反映了什麼樣的組織設計理念？
blocks.en: In Table 3.1.3-1, why do all three roles include "Escalates contamination hazards"? What organizational design philosophy does this reflect?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: CCS 是多層架構：由基礎要素（科學知識、QRM、品質文化）、個別控制元素、確效、監控、治理五個層級組成，並透過回饋迴路（調查、變更管制、CAPA）持續改進
blocks.en: The CCS is a multi-layered architecture: it consists of five levels, namely the foundational elements (scientific knowledge, QRM, quality culture), individual control elements, validation, monitoring, and governance, and it keeps improving through feedback loops (investigation, change control, CAPA)

blocks.zh: 科學知識是雙面的：既需要了解你自己的製程特性（Process Knowledge），也需要掌握防污染的通用技術原理（Technical Knowledge）
blocks.en: Scientific knowledge has two sides: you need to understand the characteristics of your own process (Process Knowledge) and also master the general technical principles of contamination prevention (Technical Knowledge)

blocks.zh: QRM 驅動設計決策：風險管理原則指導控制措施的設計，核心概念是「冗餘控制」——不允許單一失效點。在設計階段的工程投資可大幅降低長期營運成本
blocks.en: QRM drives design decisions: risk management principles guide the design of control measures, and the core concept is "redundant control", with no single point of failure allowed. Engineering investment at the design stage can greatly reduce long-term operating costs

blocks.zh: 人是最關鍵的因素：品質文化決定了所有技術措施能否被確實執行。非責怪文化、持續教育（而非僅訓練）、以及賦予現場人員「守護者」角色，是 CCS 成功的關鍵軟實力
blocks.en: People are the most critical factor: quality culture determines whether all technical measures are actually carried out. A non-blaming culture, ongoing education (not just training), and giving shop floor personnel the role of "guardians" are the soft capabilities that make a CCS succeed

blocks.zh: CCS 的三大基礎要素與 ICH Q10 的促進因子一致：這表明 CCS 不是獨立的新體系，而是聚焦於污染控制的品質管理系統應用
blocks.en: The three foundational elements of the CCS are consistent with the Enablers of ICH Q10: this shows that the CCS is not a new standalone system but an application of the quality management system focused on contamination control
